Muhammed Ameer, an ‘educator’ and one of the prominent faces of the Malayalam digital platform Unmasking Anomalies (UA), had an answer. “Consider”, he said, “the amount of sexual imagery men are exposed to every day, from hoardings and advertisements to models.” A man sees a sexually exposed woman and becomes sexually frustrated. Just as someone who cannot shout back at a boss might take their anger out on someone at home, he argued, sexual frustration can be taken out on a different target. This, Ameer said, was “frustration-aggression theory”.
